column1: #   github       newest tag in a GitHub repository
#   vcs          clone the PKGBUILD's git+ source and run its pkgver() function
#   antigravity  read the official Antigravity CLI release manifest
#   edge         read the Microsoft Edge beta package directory
#   multiviewer  read the official MultiViewer download page
#   widevine     read chromium-widevine-helper's RPM spec on master
#   lui          read Codeberg main branch and build.zig.zon
#   GitHub owner/repo for github and widevine, Codeberg owner/repo for lui.
#   Use "-" when the updater knows the location itself.
#   Prefix removed from upstream tags before comparing versions. Use "-" for none.
#   prerelease       consider pre-release tags (rc, beta, preview, ...)
#   transform=dots   replace dashes in the upstream version with dots
